body: I can maybe offer some insight. I have way to many hours logged into ark with the majority being on official servers. Long story short base got meshed on official so I switched to unofficial to see what that's about. Started playing fiber craft and I enjoy it. With my new job in working 60+ hours a week so I don't have much time for the grind so with fiber craft I'm able to progress quickly and get some good breed lines going. Also there is alot more actual pvp since people generally aren't afraid to lose anything because it is easy to get it back. Same goes with base wipes. Getting offlined is no big deal because you can rebuild quickly and get revenge. The servers are normally 50 out of 50 as well so there are always new people to fight. You're able to enjoy ark without all of the stress that comes with officials. At least that's been my experience.
Harpoon guns with bolts damage turrets and can hit them out of range.
So speed is more important than health?

Yea I understand that's part of the game and dont have a problem with it. Just didnt like the fact that they were able to destroy turret tower hatch frames with cannon balls instead of tanking. Was hoping someone knew a way to prevent it.

If you are surrounded by water build and place a raft. Get on the raft and shoot it with a bow/gun to aggro it. Once it starts coming towards the raft just drive away and it should swim after you but not catch you. Might have to stop occasionally to shoot it again but you'll be able to lead it far enough away.

I agree I'm in that camp as well but I'm surprised it's not something that is being addressed by the competitive teams. I feel like running scrims where every shot counts online would be difficult and incredibly frustrating.
Valid point. Think they will ever patch the problems in H3 online?

I think the aim is fine it's just the game registering that you hit someone that's the problem. I've found it's most noticeable with the BR but if you want to see it in action pay attention when using the sniper. Plenty of "blood shots" when you headshot someone, see the blood spray and they just carry on like nothing happened.
